name: Measure
overview: Scripture presents 'Measure' as a precise and practical standard for daily living and worship, emphasizing God's provision and order. For example, Abraham's preparation of three measures of fine meal (Genesis 18:6) illustrates readiness and hospitality, while the omer, a tenth of an ephah, regulated the Israelites' gathering of manna to meet their needs without excess or deficiency (Exodus 16:16, 18, 36). Additionally, measurements such as the handbreadth and span (Exodus 25:25; 28:16) demonstrate God's detailed instructions for sacred objects, underscoring the importance of exactness in honoring Him.
